decisions_log.decision: TitleSearch.tsx placed at components/changelog/TitleSearch.tsx as a sibling to YearFilter.tsx
decisions_log.rationale: The spec requires this exact path. It follows the established repo pattern of keeping each filter control in its own focused, testable file (per memory K and the design doc).

decisions_log.decision: Empty-state message 'No entries match.' is shown for ALL cases where filtered.length === 0, including an empty entries prop (no entries in data at all)
decisions_log.rationale: The spec says 'IF the combined filters match no entries THEN display No entries match.' — the combined filters include the implicit 'all years / all text' default, so an empty dataset also triggers it. The existing AC10 test was updated accordingly. The old behaviour (empty feed element) was inconsistent with the new empty-state requirement.

decisions_log.decision: The filter row uses a flex div in ChangelogFilteredList; YearFilter's own mb-4 wrapper div provides the bottom margin for the row
decisions_log.rationale: Adding a second mb-4 on the parent container would double the bottom margin. Since YearFilter already carries mb-4 on its root div, the parent wrapper omits it to avoid duplication without modifying YearFilter.tsx.

decisions_log.decision: Escape-to-clear (the 'should' requirement) was not implemented in this change
decisions_log.rationale: The design doc explicitly lists it as an engineer's choice deferred decision. With the 8 'must' acceptance criteria all covered and tests passing, this is a low-risk omission suitable for a follow-up.

decisions_log.decision: The × clear button uses a raw glyph (×) rather than a Heroicon
decisions_log.rationale: The design doc lists the visual affordance as an engineer's call. A raw glyph avoids any dependency on the Heroicons library (though it is already installed) and keeps the component self-contained.

deferred_questions.question: The 'should' criterion (Escape-to-clear: focus stays in the input after Escape clears the value) is not covered by a test because the feature was not implemented in this change. The design doc marks it as an engineer's deferred decision. If it should be implemented, a follow-up task is needed.

files_changed.summary: New 'use client' component with a visible 'Search' label, controlled text input, and a 'Clear search' ×  button (rendered only when the input holds non-whitespace text). Styled to match YearFilter using the existing zinc/border/rounded/px-2/py-1/text-sm Tailwind classes.

Added searchQuery useState; composed TitleSearch alongside YearFilter in a flex row; replaced the two-step year-only filter with a single combined AND filter (year + case-insensitive substring title match, whitespace-only treated as empty); renders 'No entries match.' in place of ChangelogList when the combined result is empty.

New acceptance test file covering AC1–AC8 end-to-end via ChangelogFilteredList. Uses a discriminating three-entry fixture (two 'dark' titles in different cases, one 2025 entry) to distinguish correct from plausible-wrong implementations for case-insensitivity, substring matching, AND combination, no-match state, clear control, and whitespace handling.
Updated AC10 empty-state test: the empty dataset now produces 'No entries match.' text and no feed element, matching the new ChangelogFilteredList behaviour.

self_assessment.notes: All 8 acceptance criteria are covered by tests in __tests__/changelog/title-search.test.tsx. All 182 tests pass (npm test --watchman=false). Lint (eslint) and TypeScript (tsc --noEmit) both pass with no errors. No new npm runtime dependencies were introduced. The match logic is exactly title.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase()) as required. The clear control is a real <button type='button'> with aria-label='Clear search'. The empty-state message is the exact string 'No entries match.' per AC5 and the spec.
